lines.t: The General Assembly has two houses: a Senate of not more than 56 members, each elected from a single-member district, and a House of Representatives of not fewer than 180 members (Ga. Const. Art. III, Sec. I, Para. I; Sec. II, Para. I).

src.s: Ga. Const. Art. III, Sec. I, Para. I

src.s: Ga. Const. Art. III, Sec. II, Para. I

lines.t: Members serve two-year terms, until the next General Assembly convenes (Art. III, Sec. II, Para. V). Regular sessions begin the second Monday in January and last no more than 40 days in the aggregate each year (Art. III, Sec. IV, Para. I), so the members elected on Nov. 3, 2026 take office when the 2027 session convenes on Jan. 11, 2027.

src.s: Ga. Const. Art. III, Sec. IV, Para. I

lines.t: At election, senators must be at least 25 and representatives at least 21; both must be U.S. citizens, Georgia citizens for at least two years and legal residents of their district for at least one year (Art. III, Sec. II, Para. III).

src.t: Ga. Const. Art. III, Sec. II, Para. III (Qualifications of members of General Assembly): Constitution of the State of Georgia, text as amended through Nov. 2020 (Official Code of Georgia Annotated Release 86, Public.Resource.Org)
src.s: Ga. Const. Art. III, Sec. II, Para. III

lines.t: The House elects its Speaker and a Speaker Pro Tempore from its members; the Senate elects a President Pro Tempore from its members; the Lieutenant Governor is President of the Senate (Art. III, Sec. III, Paras. I-II; Art. V, Sec. I, Para. III).

lines.t: Bills raising revenue or appropriating money must start in the House (Art. III, Sec. V, Para. II), and a bill may cover only one subject, expressed in its title (Para. III).

lines.t: The Governor may veto a bill; overriding takes two-thirds of the members to which each house is entitled (Art. V, Sec. II, Para. IV; Art. III, Sec. V, Para. XIII).

lines.t: A constitutional amendment needs a two-thirds roll-call vote of the members of each house, then ratification by a majority of voters at the next even-year general election, and takes effect the following January 1 unless it provides otherwise (Art. X, Sec. I, Paras. II and VI), so amendments ratified on Nov. 3, 2026 would take effect Jan. 1, 2027.
